categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of precision machined parts and continuous cast iron pieces. It operates through two main business segments: continuous cast iron products (including ball graphite cast iron and gray cast iron) and precision machined parts (including air compressor components, hydraulic equipment components, transmission equipment components, and robot structural components). The company serves as a strategic supplier to major equipment manufacturers in industries including air compression, hydraulic systems, and robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is horizontal continuous casting process for producing high-quality cast iron, which differs from traditional sand casting by ensuring material uniformity and high yield rates. The company employs advanced water-cooled continuous casting equipment and rare earth alloy treatment to produce ball-shaped graphite structures, enhancing mechanical properties. For precision machining, the company utilizes multi-axis CNC machining centers and advanced processing techniques to achieve micrometer-level precision. The company has mastered five core process technologies including raw material ratio control, trace element addition, supercooling control, graphite sleeve structure design, and pulling speed control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are leading global and domestic equipment manufacturers including Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, Bosch Rexroth, Danfoss, Haitian Group, and SANY Heavy Industry. End markets include air compression equipment, hydraulic systems, injection molding machines, industrial robots, new energy vehicles, and transmission equipment. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with 2024 domestic revenue representing 85.59% and international revenue 14.41% of total sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and main manufacturing facilities in Cheng'an County, Handan City, Hebei Province. It has established subsidiaries in Suzhou and Changshu in Jiangsu Province for precision machining operations. The company also maintains international business relationships and exports to multiple countries. Geographic segments show domestic market concentration at 85.59% with growing international presence at 14.41%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (pig iron, scrap steel, ferrosilicon, spheroidizing agents) from upstream suppliers, performs core manufacturing through continuous casting and precision machining, and supplies finished precision components to downstream equipment manufacturers. The company has integrated vertically by establishing a supply chain management subsidiary to optimize material sourcing and logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on advancing continuous cast iron technology and expanding precision machining capabilities. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-strength ball graphite cast iron, optimizing casting process parameters, advancing CNC machining techniques for complex components, and developing robot-related precision parts. The company invested 38.66 million yuan in R&D in 2024 (3.74% of revenue) and maintains collaborative research relationships with Xi'an University of Technology. Strategic priorities include deepening applications in air compression and hydraulic equipment while aggressively pursuing humanoid robot component opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision machined parts and continuous cast iron products to major equipment manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also operates a distribution model through authorized dealers for continuous cast iron products, using buy-out sales with prepayment terms. The company offers volume-based pricing discounts and sales rebates to distributors. 2024 revenue composition: direct sales 87.48%, distribution 12.52%, with product mix of continuous cast iron 32.78%, air compressor components 22.01%, hydraulic equipment components 33.05%, and transmission components 2.52%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to the China Foundry Association, the company holds the leading position in the horizontal continuous casting industry domestically with 63% domestic market share and ranks second globally with 19% market share (by unit sales). The company competes with traditional sand casting manufacturers and other continuous casting producers. Its competitive advantages include superior product quality, lower production costs, established customer relationships with global OEMs, and integrated one-stop service capabilities. The company positions itself as a premium supplier of high-performance precision components rather than competing on price alone.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized precision equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.033 billion yuan, representing 16.91% growth from 2023's 883.27 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 69.67 million yuan in 2024, down 44.99% from 126.65 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to increased asset impairment provisions. The company has shown consistent revenue growth over three years (2022: 863.78 million yuan) but experienced profit margin compression in 2024. Total assets reached 2.738 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 16.03% from 2.359 billion yuan in 2023, reflecting significant capital investments in production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's primary value proposition is delivering high-performance, cost-effective precision components through its proprietary continuous casting technology combined with advanced machining capabilities. Key differentiators include: (1) Superior material properties - continuous cast iron offers higher strength, better machinability, and lower defect rates compared to traditional sand casting; (2) One-stop solution - integrated casting and machining services reduce customer supply chain complexity; (3) Cost advantage - lighter weight than forged steel reduces material costs while maintaining performance; (4) Quality consistency - advanced process control ensures uniform material properties and tight tolerances; (5) Established relationships - long-term partnerships with global OEMs provide supply chain stability. The company emphasizes reliability, precision, and total cost of ownership optimization for customers.
